user.title: Emmeti AQ-IoT
user.description: Enter the credentials you use on the Emmeti AQ-IoT web app.

groups.title: Groups
groups.description: Group codes, one per line. The Emmeti API has no endpoint to list them: open the Emmeti web app with the browser network inspector (F12) and read them from the realtime-data requests. They look like FB-AMB-DT@Dxxxxx@Txxxxx.

data_description.polling_interval: The web app is slow: values may take up to twice this interval to refresh.
data_description.groups: One per line. Add a group here to create its entities, remove one to stop polling it.
data_description.show_unmapped: Off by default: about a hundred registers are not yet identified and would write a state every polling cycle. Turn it on to help map them; the debug log and the diagnostics download work either way.

error.no_groups_found: Enter at least one group code.
